purpose: Machine-readable drift and change-monitoring baseline for known Goofish/Xianyu pages.

monitorTierDefinitions.S1_STRUCTURE_MONITOR: Low-risk or public structure pages; accept layout and label drift, stop on private params or commit controls.
monitorTierDefinitions.S2_REDACTED_MONITOR: Logged-in, data, finance, file or seller pages; compare structure only with redaction.
monitorTierDefinitions.S3_HIGH_RISK_READ_ONLY: High-risk read-only pages; any action, state or private value escalation stops refresh.
monitorTierDefinitions.S3_CONTEXT_GATED: Known page requires user-provided context; do not fabricate params.
monitorTierDefinitions.S4_STATIC_OR_MODULE: Static, module or bundle-only signal; do not live probe merely for coverage.
monitorTierDefinitions.S4_BOUNDARY_ONLY: Login, iframe, shell, app bridge or download boundary; identify boundary only.

driftDecisionOrder: normalize route shape and parameter names
compare anchors, states and control categories
apply alertRules before recording any update
persist only structural labels when privacyCheckPassed is true
globalStopSignals: missing user-provided context for context-gated page
